description.narrative: The project is implemented in Palestine. The main outcome areas it contributes to are countering the threats to democracy and human rights, promoting peace and dialogue, and increasing gender equality. The main rights holders are marginalized people in East Jerusalem outside the Israel separation barrier. Through advocacy and campaigning, policy formulation, youth activities, training of professionals, workshops and sessions on mental health as human right the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Al Marfa Councelling Center and the The Palme Center. The project is implemented with the support of The Union for Professionals, Akademikerförbundet SSR (Akademikerförbundet SSR).Al Marfa Councelling Center is a civil society organisation working for social-psycholigcal health in the suburbs of East Jerusalem. Through combining consulting activities with popular education on human rights and democracy with advocacy and networking, Al Marfa promotes active citizenship of marginalised groups, with a focus on children, youth and women, involving them in social development.Other Donors to the OrganisationNo other current donors.Project ObjectiveAl Marfa seeks to grow as a main promoter of mental health and wellbeing as a human right and support social inclusion and counter social marginalisation. They seek to improve their sustainability and become a leading democratic organisations in the field of mental well-being and social inclusion, as well as promoting local activism. The objective is also to raise awareness and provide tools in order to improve psychosocial health in the targeted communities, and to increase the levels of voluntary work and local activism.Actor groupsDecision-makers: Local councils, local politicians, principals in the target area (suburbs of East Jerusalem), as well as policy makers and law makers on local, regional and national level.Actors in cooperation: Other civil society organisations and the networks of which Al Marfa is a member. Al Marfa further networks and cooperates with universitites, schools and health care centers.Rights holders: Women and young people and other marginalised people in East Jerusalem suburbs.
